fields.name: Height of station ground above mean sea level
notes: (see Note 3)

Height of station ground above mean sea level is defined as the height above mean sea level of the ground on which the rain gauge stands or, if there is no rain gauge,the ground beneath the thermometer screen. If there is neither rain gauge nor screen, it is the average level of terrain in the vicinity of the station (Reference: Guide to Meteorological Instruments and Methods of Observation (WMO-No. 8), 1996).

fields.name: Height of barometer above mean sea level
notes: (see Note 4)
Height of barometer above mean sea level, referring to the location of barometer of a station, does not redefine the descriptor 0 07 030.

fields.name: Height of sensor above local ground (or deck of marine platform)
notes: (see Note 5)

Height of sensor above local ground (or deck of marine platform) is the actual height of sensor above ground (or deck of marine platform) at the point where the sensor is located. This descriptor does not redefine the descriptors 0 07 030 or 0 07 033. Previously defined value of 0 07 032 may be cancelled by setting 0 07 032 to a"missing value".
